design: Complete 2^4 Prompt/Data/Tool/Workflow factorial with scratch_micro fixed. This is the primary loop-layer comparison because it contains every P/D/T/W combination; model adaptation is a separate paired extension.

prompt.low: generic finite-table instruction with no mechanism wording
prompt.high: structured residual-evidence instruction with an explicit non-causal interpretation boundary

data.low: random acquisition only from the pre-materialized label-blind tree
data.high: random-or-geometry-coverage acquisition from the same label-blind tree with source-index provenance

tool.low: raw validation-metric receipt; no typed residual-class tool
tool.high: registered validation_residual_v1 diagnostic with a typed finite action interface

workflow.low: static five-stage schedule fixed before the first training round
workflow.high: five-stage observation -> finite decision -> retraining workflow, with no independent-evaluation feedback

model.high: excluded from this full P/D/T/W block; evaluated later in a paired naive/LoRA/freeze/replay model-method extension after foundation admission

execution_contract.unit: Every one of the 16 P/D/T/W cells is a matched four-arm five-round episode on the two development molecules and a common seed.
execution_contract.primary_screening_response: Within every cell, compare outer_generated against information_removed using final validation force/energy, five-round validation area-under-curve, labels-to-threshold, and cumulative wall time. Independent evaluation is released only after the matched four-arm barrier and is not an outer-policy input.
execution_contract.g1_rule: Only validation-only development trajectories from the g0 generation may be supplied to a new bounded outer policy proposal. The g1 generation uses a fresh development seed.
execution_contract.holdout_rule: A pre-registered validation-only promotion rule selects one frozen g0/g1 policy before the toluene policy holdout.
